Ash Formula Avocado Night Fairness Cream and Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream are both avocado night creams sold online in India, but they differ on price, sizes, ingredient information and how results are described. The Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream (30 g) costs ₹649 and lists its ingredients: avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. When we checked on 4 November 2026, Ash Formula's product page showed a price range of ₹300 to ₹1,500 across four sizes and did not list ingredients on the page.

We make Mirc Glow, so this is a comparison from our side. Everything about Ash Formula below comes from its public product page, which you can open yourself. Check their page again before you buy, because prices and details change.

What to check before buying any avocado night cream

  • Is the ingredient list shown? You should be able to read what is in a cream before you put it on your face. If it is not on the page, ask the seller or check the label on the jar.
  • Does it list kojic acid or other actives? Kojic acid can irritate some skin, so you should know if a cream has it and patch test first.
  • How fast does it promise results? Skin renews about every 4 to 6 weeks. A cream that promises a clear change in 10 days is promising more than most skincare can honestly deliver, so give any cream 8 to 12 weeks before judging it.
  • Does it claim to change your skin colour? No cosmetic changes natural skin tone. Look for wording such as softer, smoother and more even-looking.
  • Is the size right? A 30 g jar used in a pea-sized amount each night lasts about 6 to 8 weeks.

Who should choose which?

Choose Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream if you want a clear ingredient list, a single 30 g jar at a fixed price, free shipping on every order and Cash on Delivery, and you prefer honest wording about results.

Ash Formula may suit you if you want a small 15 g size to try, or a larger 50 g or 100 g jar. Read the ingredient information on the jar before you use it.

How to use either one safely

  1. Patch test behind the ear and wait 24 hours.
  2. Apply a pea-sized amount on clean skin in the evening, as the last step.
  3. Start every other night, then go nightly if your skin is calm.
  4. Wear sunscreen every morning.
  5. Stop if you get lasting redness, burning or itching. Pregnant, breastfeeding or have a skin condition? Ask a doctor first.

Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

Which is cheaper, Ash Formula or Mirc Glow avocado night cream?

Ash Formula's page showed ₹300 to ₹1,500 depending on size, so the smallest jar costs less. Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream is ₹649 for 30 g, about ₹21.6 per gram. Compare the price per gram of the size you would actually buy.

Does Mirc Glow Avocado Night Cream make skin fairer?

No. It helps skin feel softer and look smoother and more even over time. It does not change your natural skin tone.

Can I use it with sunscreen?

Yes, and you should. Use sunscreen every morning, because creams with kojic acid make a daily SPF important.

How long before I see a difference?

Skin feels more moisturised from the first nights. A more even look usually takes 8 to 12 weeks of regular use.
